classes.basis: Contract §3.1: candidate is explicitly not usage; all applicable usage containers are present and empty; missing/bad-type usage fails closed; frozen treats candidates as usage (over-strict).
classes.r2_impact: Sound only for turns whose blocker is the candidate layer; public aggregate cannot confirm the exact axes.

classes.basis: Query-state candidates are prior-turn retrieval candidates, not current-turn usage; query_states_available=True required; missing/bad state_json fails closed. Note: multi_turn_partial_empty also has retrieval candidates (7+2 is attribution, not a disjoint count).
classes.r2_impact: Same as above; no confirmed axis.

classes.basis: Contract §3.2: candidate_observation=not_observed with candidates=[] is NOT empty-set evidence; the marker is a deterministic echo of 'no retrieval_observed event and path != rag'; it is the sole difference between proven and not proven (removing it fails closed); frozen required an actual retrieval observation. This is the taskbook's 'treat no retrieval event as no used source' pattern.
classes.r2_impact: The 2 stale_source axes whose reason is model_events_missing would flip; these flips are NOT sound. Keep them unknown.

classes.basis: Contract §3.1 lists inheritance as a usage layer; frozen omits it; the new implementation is stricter and cannot create a false proven.
classes.r2_impact: Conservative direction; may reduce proofs, never creates a false pass.

axes.basis_not_sound: model_events_missing = class C; marker is the sole difference; contract §3.2 says not_observed is not empty-set evidence
axes.basis_partially_sound: empty_set_not_proven axes could be class A/B (sound) or missing-field shapes (the new module also fails closed); public data cannot confirm
axes.note: The 13 source_unresolved axes are not affected because the empty proof is not invoked when usage layers are non-empty.

axes.basis: The audit ref exists, but the axis-level reason is targets_unresolved/free_text; a flip to pass or N/A is sound only for A/B shapes and is blocked by contract entity targets anyway.

r2_axis_flip.case_level_upper_bound: 2/30 (optimistic, if the cross_entity axis's case has no other required unknown); 24/30 remains unreachable
r2_axis_flip.conclusion: The claim that 6 stale + 1 cross_entity axes would mostly flip to pass is not supported: 2 flips are unsound, at most 3 are shape-dependent and unconfirmed, and case-level pass remains at most 2/30.

residuals.summary: Unknown keys inside state_json are not fail-closed (same as frozen primitive); e.g. {"candidates": [], "used_sources": [...]} still proves.

Class C (2 cases) treats v0.3 candidate_observation=not_observed as positive no-retrieval evidence, contrary to contract §3.2; it is the sole difference making them proven. Blocking for C1-2 integration.
The 22 'shape' labels include 5 gap labels; they are not 22 business shapes.
Query_state observed/saved/cleared event paths are not covered by the 72-case corpus (0/72); only db_projection.query_states is covered.
Not covered: multi-turn with current usage, RAG query_expansion with non-empty evidence, valid multiple retrieval events.
All not-proven shapes collapse to empty_set_not_proven, losing the frozen primitive's finer reasons; a C1-2 consumer using reason as a fixed code would lose diagnostic traceability.
multi_turn_partial_empty is attributed to query_state but structurally also has retrieval candidates; 7+2 is not a disjoint shape count.
The differential summary asserts extension_proven > 0, not == 11; per-case parametrization pins the cases but a removed case would not fail the summary assertion.
Not wired into p2_evidence_rescore.py / p2_evidence_rescore_axes.py (developer's R-C1P2-01); this package cannot produce real R2 numbers.
Entity inheritance is counted as usage (stricter); can only reduce proofs, never create a false pass.
